# A customer, a vendor, an invoice and a bill, all in CAD.
#
# All four kinds, because the refusal below says a different sentence for an
# owner than for a record — an owner's currency is what their invoices and
# bills are created in, a record's is what its lines are denominated in — and
# a fixture holding three of the four leaves one of those sentences unread.
#
# `currency:` is required on each of these blocks and written back by every
# export, so it reads as a field like any other — and on an object the book
# already holds it was neither compared nor applied. Editing it reported
# `unchanged`, the book kept the currency it was created with, and the next
# export wrote that currency back over the edit: the ledger and the book
# disagreeing for good, with the ledger losing and nothing said.
#
# Applying it is not a small edit either — an owner's currency is what their
# invoices and bills are created in, and a posted invoice's is what its AR
# splits are denominated in — so it is refused rather than absorbed.
#
# owners_with_the_customer_in_usd.txt, owners_with_the_vendor_in_usd.txt,
# owners_with_the_invoice_in_usd.txt and owners_with_the_bill_in_usd.txt are
# this file with one object's currency changed, one file each because the
# import stops at the first it refuses.
#
# What this fixture produces: two owners, one invoice and one bill, in CAD.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_changing_an_objects_currency_is_refused.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-CCY"
	name: "Acme Supplies"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-CCY"
	name: "Beta Printing"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CCY"
	customer_id: "C-CCY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false

bill "BILL-CCY"
	vendor_id: "V-CCY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
